name: Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares - Après le § 38 - Am 20
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 51. Reiterates the need for sustainable and resilient revenue for the Union budget that should match the expenditure side; expresses its continued conviction that without the introduction of new genuine own resources to finance the Union’s budget, the financial burden will inevitably fall on Member States through increased GNI-based contributions; considers, therefore, that the introduction of new revenue streams is an essential condition for an ambitious MFF 2028-2034; points out, on the other hand, that the increase in revenue financed through new genuine own resources should be coupled with the progressive reduction in gross national income-based contributions from the Member States, in order to increase the financial autonomy of the Union;
